tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: 3D viewport ground and 2D profile canvas. The deepest surface, so the rocket reads as the brightest object.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: App window background, top bar, status strip.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Side panels: parts bin, inspector, Station Lanes.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Inputs, part tiles, raised rows inside a panel.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, tiles and buttons.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel frames, section rules, lane separators, minor grid. Decorative only, never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Control borders and overlay frames (overlays have no shadow, just this 1px frame). 3:1 against bg-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on any bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, secondary text, units suffixes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Section headers (uppercase), placeholders, disabled values. 4.5:1 on bg-300.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Shock orange. Selection brackets, primary buttons, focus, the active tab underline, live drag values. One meaning: 'this is what you are acting on'.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Drop-zone and snap-target fill ONLY. Selection never uses a wash; it uses accent brackets and outlines.

tokens.name: cg
tokens.usage: Centre of gravity. Marker, readout and every CG plot line. Always blue, always the quartered-circle glyph.

tokens.name: cp
tokens.usage: Centre of pressure. Marker, readout and every CP plot line. Always red, always the dot-in-ring glyph; never used for errors.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Stable margin band, passing checks, valid attach node.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: marginal stability, diameter mismatch, fin flutter risk.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Errors: unstable, invalid geometry, illegal drop. Pair with an icon; never confuse with cp, which is a quantity, not a state.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: Gizmo / axis triad X (radial).

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Gizmo / axis triad Y (radial).

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Gizmo / axis triad Z (along the rocket's axis, the one axis most handles move on).

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Viewport minor grid on bg-000.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Viewport major grid lines and the rocket axis centreline.

tokens.name: part-body
tokens.usage: Structure system colour, and the default airframe shading base in the viewport (nose, tubes, rings, bulkheads).

tokens.name: part-fin
tokens.usage: Default fin / flat-plate shading base in Solid view.

tokens.name: sys-aero
tokens.usage: Aero system: fins, canards, rail buttons, lugs. The edge of Aero bars in Station Lanes and Aero parts in X-ray / Cutaway.

tokens.name: sys-propulsion
tokens.usage: Propulsion system: motor mount, motor, engine block, thrust ring, retainer. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

tokens.name: sys-recovery
tokens.usage: Recovery system: chutes, drogue, shock cord, harness, charges. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

tokens.name: sys-avionics
tokens.usage: Avionics & payload system: altimeters, batteries, trackers, payload, ballast. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

tokens.name: lane-structure
tokens.usage: Station Lanes: Structure bar fill. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: lane-aero
tokens.usage: Station Lanes: Aero bar fill.

tokens.name: lane-propulsion
tokens.usage: Station Lanes: Propulsion bar fill.

tokens.name: lane-recovery
tokens.usage: Station Lanes: Recovery bar fill.

tokens.name: lane-avionics
tokens.usage: Station Lanes: Avionics & payload bar fill.

tokens.name: cut-face
tokens.usage: Hatching on cut faces in Cutaway view (airframe walls, rings, bulkheads where the section plane passes).

tokens.name: cut-interior
tokens.usage: The inside of the airframe exposed by Cutaway, behind the internals.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 1 (aqua). Fixed order, never cycled. Validated with slots 2–4: CVD ΔE ≥ 8.4 dark / 9.1 light.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 2 (yellow). Below 3:1 on light, so ship direct labels or a table.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 3 (violet).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 4 (magenta). More than 4 series → fold into Other or use small multiples.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Default UI text: labels, list rows, menus.

styles.name: ui-section
styles.usage: Uppercase mono panel section headers in ink-faint, prefixed with a two-digit index.

styles.name: num-body
styles.usage: Every editable value and every readout. Tabular, so digits don't shift while dragging.

styles.name: num-readout
styles.usage: Headline stability margin in the status strip and gauge.

styles.name: num-label
styles.usage: Viewport labels on CG/CP markers and dimension lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, unit suffix gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a row; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding; gap between inspector rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Viewport overlay inset from edges.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, dialog padding.

radius.note: Square by default. Bowshock is drawn like a technical drawing: frames, rules and brackets, not pills and cards.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, buttons, inputs, overlays, tiles, chips, lane blocks.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Only to soften 1px anti-aliasing on tiny marks (badge, unit chip hover). Never visible as a curve.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, buttons, segmented controls. Dense on purpose: the inspector must show a full fin set without scrolling.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom status strip height.

tokens.name: right-panel-w
tokens.usage: Inspector column default width (resizable 260–440).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Parts bin category rail width (icons only).

tokens.name: bin-w
tokens.usage: Parts bin list width (resizable 200–360).

tokens.name: part-row-h
tokens.usage: Parts bin row: silhouette + name + default size.

tokens.name: lanes-h
tokens.usage: Station Lanes default height under the viewport: 24 px ruler, five lanes with one sub-row, 20 px balance footer (grows with sub-rows; collapsible to its ruler).

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: One lane in Station Lanes. A lane with overlapping parts adds 22 px sub-rows.

tokens.name: bracket
tokens.usage: Leg length of selection corner brackets, in the viewport and the Station Lanes.
